name: M78 (Hello Watch 3+ / openWatchOS reference)
sold_as: ND326 uses the same platform (identical button and display tables)

evidence: official app of the watch; SDK packages via wreck apk
companion_app.label: Companion app (name, package, version)

evidence: chip id in the flash header of the update file
structure matches the public JL701N watch SDK
chip.label: SoC / chip family

value.external: 16 MB NOR (resources, watch faces, update staging)

evidence: full 16 MiB NOR export from own device
flash_layout.label: Flash layout (internal/external, banks, regions)

steps: transfer via Bluetooth by the running vendor firmware into a staging area in external NOR
trigger via hand-over in RAM + reboot
write by a loader taken from the update file, no Bluetooth needed

evidence: analysis of the update flow (private report)
update_path.label: How firmware gets onto the watch (DFU/OTA flow)

value.pattern: own code only in PSRAM, started by the unmodified vendor firmware; every reboot returns to the original. Additionally: fallback firmware via the official update function.
value.hardware_reset: hold crown 8 s = reboot (not a firmware way back)

evidence: device test 2026-11-19: code from PSRAM, reboot → original firmware
device test: return to earlier firmware confirmed
recovery.label: Proven way back if an experiment fails

value.controller: SH8601-family command set, driver name in firmware 'GP3112'; chip ID open

evidence: init table found via DCS 2A/2B (wreck scan)
pins read on the device with an own diagnostic app
own code draws on the display (device test 2026-11-19)
display.label: Display (resolution, interface, controller)

value.bus: software I²C SCL PG03 / SDA PG04
value.report: 3 bytes: event (bits 6/7 = 9th bit of x/y), x, y; controller only answers when it has an event

evidence: own touch driver with vendor firmware halted, device test 2026-11-20
touch.label: Touch controller (bus, address, pins)

value.crown_rotation: rotary encoder decoded in software on PC06/PB07

evidence: button diagnostic app, repeated three times
port inputs read with own program
buttons.label: Buttons, crown, reset

value.path: Settings → General → System, then tap the bottom-right corner five times
value.shows: burn-in test, sensors, buttons/crown, touch, MAC, firmware/hardware version

evidence: derived from the touch handling of the system page; not yet opened on the device
factory_menu.label: Factory test / service menu

value.package: .oapps (tar) with app.json, app.js, i18n, optional phone part

evidence: several own apps confirmed on the device (clock, Sokoban, noise meter, web apps)
app_layer.label: Own app layer (e.g. script apps)

notes: A build with two changes (boot logo + AOD) caused a boot loop – since then one change per build.
A program that permanently occupies the vendor firmware's UI task blocks notifications, sync and updates; it needs its own task.
Addresses and patch locations inside the vendor firmware are deliberately not part of this public profile.
